title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Civil Dispute Cases Involving the Recognition of Well-known Trademarks
keywords_en: civil disputes concerning recognition of well-known trademarks
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Jurisdiction over Civil Dispute Cases Involving the Recognition of Well-known Trademarks

Fa [2009] No. 1

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to further strengthen the judicial protection of well-known trademarks by the people's courts, improve the judicial protection system, regulate judicial protection practices, enhance the authority and credibility of judicial protection, maintain a fair and competitive market economic order, and serve the overall national economic development, effective from the date of issuance of this notice, civil dispute cases involving the recognition of well-known trademarks shall be under the jurisdiction of the Intermediate People's Courts of the cities where the people's governments of provinces and autonomous regions are located, the Intermediate People's Courts of cities specifically designated in the state plan, and the Intermediate People's Courts within the jurisdictions of municipalities directly under the Central Government. Other Intermediate People's Courts shall, before assuming jurisdiction over such civil dispute cases, report to and obtain approval from the Supreme People's Court; Intermediate People's Courts that have not obtained such approval shall no longer accept such cases.

All relevant parties are requested to comply with the above notice.

January 5, 2009
